## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, change and acceptance criteria. Link the issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and relevant evidence. Explain any untested behavior.

## Compatibility and operations

Note API/protocol changes, consumers, migrations and rollback where applicable.
For crypto changes: threat-model impact, vectors, parameter provenance and reviewer.

- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal credential data or generated key material are included.
- [ ] Existing licenses and contributor attribution are preserved.
